Name: (CP) RAINBOW. Salmonberry Bushes - Blackberry Bushes - Gem Geode
Author: Brittanyskitty
Description:
Do you have trouble noticing the bushes with berries on it? Do you have your friends cringe as you happily pass Gem Geodes without noticing them? I, too, had this problem until the bushes and gem geode got a very lovely RAINBOW makeover from IneiDarkness.

This is a personal mod that was created to help make these features standout as I'm rather nearsighted. However, we figured it wouldn't hurt sharing in case anyone else needed some extra visibility.

[b]Note:[/b] This most likely will conflict with any mod that changes the bushes or gem geode. My apologizes.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
